page.overview:
What is Hell?

Hell is a black-aligned plane, with connections to various other planes. Full of heat and magma, it is home to the forces of Hell: demons, devils, and bogeymen. It may be the same location as The Abyss. Figuratively, planes like Phyrexia are sometimes compared to Hell.

Creatures of Hell are seen or mentioned on Dominaria and Ravnica. Innistrad has the Devils' Breach in Kessig and the Ashmouth in Stensia.

Hell was visited by the sun priest Helana and the Demonic Tutor Illith to free Helena's adopted father Koborah. During the planeswalking journey (which was enabled by a "Sun-Stone") she picked up so much black magic that she went over from worshiping the Sun to worshiping Gohrah, the dark side of the moon. After freeing Koborah and returning home, Helana had to give up her priesthood and leave the parish.

entity.description:
Hell is a depiction of an afterlife in religion and folklore, commonly associated with burning, torment and punishment in the Earth's underground. Although primarily associated with Abrahamic religions, analogues officially translated as or colloquially called "Hell" are also found in many many religions.
